BDI.note: Procurement under the project is mentioned only as not yet reviewed; no e-procurement system.
Central bank statement is a commitment to join EAPS, not in service; no stated mandate, licensing or switch oversight.

facts.fact: Burundi has pledged to join the East African Payment System by December 2026 and its integration project components were unfinished when the African Development Bank grant closed in June, the East African Legislative Assembly Committee on Accounts reported.
BurundiPay, an instant-payment platform launched on 23 April, connects eight banks, four payment institutions and 21 microfinance institutions, the committee report said.

BDI.note: No tax or fee payment stated.
